description: Tech job postings from Djinni.co's public job list (mostly Ukraine and remote roles), read from the schema.org JobPosting data on the page: title, company, location type, posted time, salary range when the employer gives one, link. Djinni shows about 15 postings per page. Related tools on this server, for a different need: jobs_governmentjobs when you need US public-sector job postings from GovernmentJobs.com; jobs_nodesk when you need newest remote job postings from NoDesk's public RSS feed. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
